desc:
🐎 **STARFALL STABLES — YOUR LEGEND STARTS HERE**

Ride, explore and build your dream ranch! Catch wild horses, train them and race other riders across a huge open world.

🌟 **UPDATE 2.0 IS HERE!**

⚡ 10 unique TREADMILLS, from Common to Ultimate
🪢 LASSO SHOP: 10 lassos to catch rarer horses
🏡 YOUR OWN PADDOCK: level it up and earn more coins
🏆 STAR CUP: a big server race every 10 minutes
🎁 HORSE CHESTS: open one for a surprise horse
🐴 NEW HORSES: Dapple Grey, Meadow Bay, Paint Palomino and a new Chestnut
🎀 NEW TACK: saddles, bridles, leg wraps and head gear
📖 HORSE INDEX: collect them all for rewards
🌦️ Day and night, rain and thunderstorms

🏇 **RIDE & RACE** — Win races and coins.
⚡ **TRAIN & UPGRADE** — Turn your horse into a champion.
🎁 **DAILY REWARDS & FREE GIFTS** — Come back every day!

👥 Join the "Starfall Stables Official" community from the game!
⭐ FAVORITE and LIKE so you don't miss the next update!
